title: Version executor schema
description: Nx executor that versions a project using @hyperfrontend/versioning. Uses npm registry as source of truth instead of git tags.

dryRun.description: See what commands would be run, without committing to git or updating files.

releaseAs.description: Manually increment the version by that keyword.

tagPrefix.description: Version tag prefix. Default is '{projectName}@' in independent mode.

trackDeps.description: Includes the project's dependencies in calculating a recommended version bump.

skipCommit.description: Allows to skip making a commit when bumping a version.

skipTag.description: Allows to skip tagging the release. Default: true (tags created after publish).

updateDependents.description: Update version references in dependent packages after version bump.

skipIfVersionCommit.description: Skip versioning if the current commit is a version/release commit (recursion prevention).

skipIfUnstableGit.description: Skip versioning if git is in rebase/merge state.

verbose.description: Enable verbose output for debugging. Shows additional details about each step.

repository.description: Repository resolution for changelog compare URLs. Options: 'disabled' (no URLs), 'inferred' (auto-detect from package.json or git remote), or an object with mode and options.

inferenceOrder.description: Order of inference sources when mode is 'inferred'. Default: ['package-json', 'git-remote']

baseUrl.description: Repository base URL (for explicit mode), e.g., 'https://github.com/owner/repo'

showDiff.description: Show unified diff of changes before committing to VFS. Useful for debugging and CI output.

diffFormat.description: Output format for diff preview: 'unified' (full patch) or 'summary' (stats only).

rollbackOnFailure.description: Discard all pending VFS changes if any step fails. Ensures no partial state remains.

backupChangelog.description: Create a backup of existing changelog before modification. Useful for safety during changelog regeneration.

scopeFiltering.description: Scope filtering configuration for commit classification and changelog generation.

includeScopes.description: Additional scopes to include as direct commits

excludeScopes.description: Scopes to exclude even if files match

trackDependencyChanges.description: Include commits that touch dependency packages as indirect commits

paths.description: Git paths to track as infrastructure (e.g., 'tools/', '.github/')
